title: I Built a Clothing Brand From $0 in One Weekend (FREE COURSE)
promo_conflict: Sponsored TapStitch build: products shipped by TapStitch and the video repeatedly promotes its quality and features

idea.name: Lifestyle-branded print-on-demand clothing brand
idea.one_liner: Launch a premium-feeling apparel brand with no inventory using a print-on-demand supplier (heavyweight polos, quarter zips, custom denim), sell the lifestyle aesthetic, and build the storefront with free Claude-generated HTML
idea.customer: online apparel shoppers in a chosen lifestyle niche
idea.revenue_model: retail markup on POD cost, e.g. $80 polos and $100+ jeans

So, when you're getting it for, you know, about $8 to $12 depending on which one you get, look at that price gap there.

claims.claim: Wife couldn't tell TapStitch leggings from $130 Alo leggings in a blind test
claims.quote: And honestly, she couldn't really feel the difference, which was amazing that you can get this product and sell it and make that sort of money

claims.claim: Almost no POD supplier offers custom denim
claims.quote: Like I said, almost nobody fulfills custom data. Not a single print on demand partner that I found.

ideas.delivery: TapStitch fulfils on order; Shopify/BigCommerce/Wix store; ChatGPT/Gemini for model imagery; branded tags and insert cards to capture emails
ideas.other_uk_rules: Product safety and textile fibre labelling regulations; CPRs on accurate quality claims
